data.rationale: The proposal follows the same procedure in the same order (origin, destination, dates, search, continue, Sort & Filter, sort, Apply) and correctly names origin, destination, dates, trip type and the points option; it lacks a distinct sort_option value (it hardcodes price low-to-high instead of using "Price by Core") and adds an unneeded 'Details' step, but a browser automation could still be built from it.
